definitions.RESTORE: R2 except selected original FP32 slice
definitions.M16: R2 except selected slice from original FP32 quantize16 global range, canonical float32 dequantization

uint16_arithmetic: Use unchanged codec.quantize(original_full_xyz,16), assert global min/max equal frozen q8 metadata, retain only chosen slice. Float32 input/extrema; Python float64 step=(b-a)/65535; float64 (x-a)/step; np.rint nearest-even; clip0..65535 before uint16 cast. dequantize float64 a+q*step, clip[a,b],castfloat32. Not normalize-then-multiply reassociation.
constant_range: codes0; reconstruction a; nonzero codes invalid
nonfinite: reject NaN/Inf input or metadata, never sanitize
scalar_reference_tolerance: codes exact; float32 recon <= eps32*max(1,abs(reference)); independent canonical replay bit-exact
baseline_reuse: verify sealed provenance and all mask/quantizer/camera/image hashes; smoke ordinal0 for R2/RESTORE per scene must have exact PNG and float RGB SHA; no post-hoc tolerance relaxation

evaluation.split: all20 official test frames in JSON order
evaluation.order: per scene: controls R2/RESTORE ordinal0, M16 all20, metrics four states
evaluation.metrics: unchanged upstream metrics.py, PSNR and SSIM functions, LPIPS VGG; PNG uint8 round-trip and [0,1] RGB inputs as upstream, no new normalization
evaluation.timing: CUDA synchronized from deform.step start through gaussian_renderer.render end; loading/image I/O excluded; first frame reported separately, no unreported warmup
evaluation.VRAM: torch max allocated/reserved render process plus sampled total device if available
evaluation.gradient_mode: new metric wrapper torch.inference_mode; model.eval; legacy values parity checked against stored controls
evaluation.LPIPS_LEGACY: lpips0.1.4 LPIPS VGG0.1 RGB[0,1] normalize=False, no external transform
evaluation.LPIPS_STANDARD_VGG: same weights RGB[0,1], normalize=True exactly once; verify explicit2*x-1 normalize=False parity

memory_guard.GPU_scope: one model per process, sequential; CUDA mem_get_info and allocated/reserved for renderer/metrics

resource_pilot: bouncingballs complete controls+M16+metrics before remaining3 scenes; no new variants
analysis: signed differences to R2/RESTORE/R0; paired view counts/ranges, no almost-FP32 threshold, no compressed-rate claim
exploratory: levels selected on prior test PSNR; not independent precision policy validation
